# mooncake drift inspect

Compare the last-applied plan against current system state

## Description

Loads last-applied plan records from agentd's state dir and runs InspectPlan to check whether re-applying would change state. With no argument, all recorded scopes are inspected. Pass a scope hash to inspect a specific record.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--state-dir` | string | - | Override agentd state dir (default: platform default) |
| `--json` | bool | false | Emit JSONL (one JSON object per scope) instead of the table |
